financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: Now Assist is a named ServiceNow AI product, but the cited product page and inaccessible Q2 release did not verify the asserted more-than-$1bn AI ARR.
ai_claim.stage: E1 product capability; paid-adoption magnitude unverified
ai_claim.scope: Now Assist workflows only; no company-wide economics.
ai_claim.limitation: No opened ARR source, deployment denominator, controlled quality result or cash bridge.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: the $1bn AI ARR disclosure establishes paid adoption, not incremental cohort margin or renewal causality.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: No source-backed annual operating-profit denominator was verified, so the prior $300m hurdle is withdrawn. Q2 subscription revenue is useful scale context but is not profit and must not be used as an earnings hurdle.

arithmetic.inputs: pool $8bn eligible internal R&D, sales and support cost (assumption); efficiency 15%; realization 50%; retained share 40%; recurring cost $250m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense

g2_provisional: Watch/incomplete: E1 product/paid-adoption claim; Q2 AI-ARR release was not successfully opened; no E3 quality-adjusted proof or E4 retained cash.
